roles.title: Modern Work Architect (FastTrack)
roles.summary: Lead customer engagements from technical readiness and architecture through production go-live across Microsoft 365 and Copilot.

items.text: Lead architecture and deployment engagements across messaging, collaboration, identity, security, compliance, endpoint management, and Copilot for public-sector customers.
Design phased migration strategies across Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, including workload sequencing, dependencies, and migration waves.
Guide identity controls, Zero Trust principles, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and Microsoft Purview to support secure deployment and governance.

Serve as regional lead for internal Microsoft Copilot deployment across the Americas. Led development and launch of 5+ business-specific AI agents using OpenAI technologies, supporting 1,000+ employees.
Partner with Sales, Engineering, Product, and customer technical teams to troubleshoot deployment blockers, coordinate escalations, and drive supportable production outcomes.

roles.title: Escalation Engineer (FastTrack)
roles.summary: Led technical delivery, troubleshooting, and escalation management for 90+ enterprise customers.

items.text: Led technical delivery and escalation management for 90+ enterprise customers, addressing complex configuration, deployment, and service-readiness issues.
Provided technical guidance across Exchange Online, Teams and Teams Phone, Active Directory, Entra ID, Windows, and modern authentication.
Mentored and trained 40+ FastTrack Engineers on modern authentication, Microsoft 365 security practices, structured troubleshooting, and enterprise deployment readiness.
Diagnosed cross-workload issues, identified root causes, and coordinated remediation with customer engineering teams and Microsoft technical stakeholders.

roles.title: Escalation Engineer (Migrations)
roles.summary: Orchestrated migrations for 850,000+ users and co-developed automation used for 3.5M+ migrations globally.

items.text: Orchestrated large-scale migrations for 850,000+ users to Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive for Business, addressing workload dependencies and production blockers.
Co-developed automation adopted by the Microsoft FastTrack Migration Engine, enabling 3.5M+ user migrations globally and improving repeatability and operational scale.
Resolved complex migration failures and delivered technical training for 15+ engineers on data protection, migration security, troubleshooting, and the Microsoft identity platform.
